error: cannot find module.name: Node module not installed
error: cannot find module.cause: The code imports a package that is not present in node_modules.
error: cannot find module.fix: Run npm install in the project root

EADDRINUSE.name: Port already in use
EADDRINUSE.cause: Another process is already listening on the port the server wants.
EADDRINUSE.fix: Stop the other process, or start the server on a different port

error MSB.name: .NET build failure
error MSB.cause: MSBuild reported an error; the message above it names the real problem.
error MSB.fix: Run dotnet build with more detail: dotnet build -v detailed

gyp ERR!.name: node-gyp build failure
gyp ERR!.cause: A native Node module could not be compiled, usually for want of build tools.
gyp ERR!.fix: Install the Visual Studio Build Tools, then rebuild with npm rebuild

fatal error: python.name: Python headers missing
fatal error: python.cause: A native extension needs the Python development headers.
fatal error: python.fix: Install the Python development headers and set PYTHONHOME, then rebuild

linker command failed.name: Linker could not resolve symbols
linker command failed.cause: A library the build expects is missing or was built for another architecture.
linker command failed.fix: Check the library search path, and rebuild any libraries that are out of date

error: unable to access.name: Repository or file could not be reached
error: unable to access.cause: A network or permission problem stopped the download.
error: unable to access.fix: Check the URL, your network connection and any proxy settings

SSL certificate problem.name: TLS certificate could not be verified
SSL certificate problem.cause: The certificate chain is incomplete or the system trust store is out of date.
SSL certificate problem.fix: Update the system root certificates, or point the build at the right CA bundle

Permission denied (publickey).name: SSH key was rejected
Permission denied (publickey).cause: The remote host does not trust the key being used, or ssh-agent has none loaded.
Permission denied (publickey).fix: Add the public key to the remote account, or load it: ssh-add ~/.ssh/id_ed25519

No space left on device.name: Disk is full
No space left on device.cause: The build ran out of disk space.
No space left on device.fix: Free up space, then clear the build cache and retry
